scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --project apps/api && docker compose -f infra/dev/compose.yaml up -d postgres postgres-test && pnpm exec playwright install chromium
scripts.dev:db: docker compose -f infra/dev/compose.yaml up -d postgres postgres-test
scripts.dev:api: uv run --project apps/api uvicorn openvietgis_api.main:app --reload --no-access-log --app-dir apps/api
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.validate:ts: pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r test && pnpm --filter @openvietgis/web build
scripts.validate:py: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api tools tests && uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/openvietgis_api && uv run --project apps/api pytest apps/api/tests/unit apps/api/tests/contract tools/tests tests/architecture
scripts.validate:integration: uv run --project apps/api python -m tools.run_with_test_database pytest apps/api/tests/integration apps/api/tests/performance
scripts.validate:e2e: uv run --project apps/api python -m tools.run_with_test_database node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.validate:e2e:bootstrap: uv run --project apps/api python -m tools.run_with_test_database node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config playwright.bootstrap.config.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm validate:runtime && pnpm validate:ts && pnpm validate:py && pnpm validate:contracts && pnpm validate:scope && pnpm validate:arch && pnpm validate:docs && pnpm validate:integration && pnpm validate:e2e && pnpm validate:e2e:bootstrap && uv run --project apps/api python tools/check_secret_surfaces.py dist/security-evidence/playwright-p1.json dist/security-evidence/playwright-bootstrap.json
scripts.validate:contracts: uv run --project apps/api python tools/check_contracts.py && pnpm contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/client-sdk/src/generated
scripts.dev:identity: docker compose -f infra/dev/compose.yaml -f infra/dev/compose.identity.yaml up -d postgres keycloak
